title: Millers look beyond Orvan as wheat cargoes slip

facts.subject: wheat
facts.statement: Midgard's flour millers are booking wheat from Vanir and asking for more rail capacity from Ravik after Orvan's sea loadings fell in September.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard's flour millers are booking wheat from Vanir and asking for more rail capacity from Ravik after Orvan's sea loadings fell in September.

facts.subject: Orvan port index
facts.statement: The Realm Trade Ministry put the September port index at 40, against an old normal of 100.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Realm Trade Ministry put the September port index at 40, against an old normal of 100.

facts.subject: corridor agreement
facts.statement: Midgard buyers had expected the corridor agreement to be renewed. It expired on 10 September without a replacement.

source_ref.text_snippet: Midgard buyers had expected the corridor agreement to be renewed. It expired on 10 September without a replacement.

facts.subject: wheat
facts.statement: We can replace some of the lost wheat, not all of it, said a purchasing manager at a Midgard mill.

source_ref.text_snippet: "We can replace some of the lost wheat, not all of it," said a purchasing manager at a Midgard mill.

validation_notes: Quote not verbatim (100% match); replaced with source text from ¶5

facts.subject: rail and sea cargo timing
facts.statement: The hardest part is not the price but the timing. A rail parcel can arrive in days, while a sea cargo takes weeks to arrange.

source_ref.text_snippet: The hardest part is not the price but the timing. A rail parcel can arrive in days, while a sea cargo takes weeks to arrange.

validation_notes: Citation repaired: quote found in ¶7, not cited ¶6

facts.subject: Vanir wheat pricing
facts.statement: Vanir wheat offers have been small and priced above Orvan's usual terms.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vanir wheat offers have been small and priced above Orvan's usual terms.
